reference.role: Edit target: current shipped tall mast; preserve nest and lower shaft

selection.reason: Muted chestnut join and restrained grain read cleanly beneath the original nest at native deck scale.

calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: image 1, the shipped pixel-art wooden mast. Regenerate this same mast with ONLY its bare pole between the crow's nest and sail attachment shortened by 32 logical pixels. Preserve the SAME crow's nest, masthead, lower shaft and navy foot, exact warm wood/navy palette, same 9px shaft width, same 19px base width. Transparent background. No sail, yard, ship, rigging ropes, text or extra objects.
Target logical canvas 48 wide by 192 high, shown at large nearest-neighbor scale. Centerline x24. Top y2. Nest bounds x6 y22 width37 height23. Small existing lugs below nest y46. Invisible sail yard attachment at y68 (do NOT draw yard). Foot anchor x24 y190. The clear shaft between nest bottom y45 and imaginary yard y68 is only 23 pixels, about one nest height. Everything from yard down to foot must preserve the current reference proportions exactly. The current reference is 48x224 with yard at y100; remove 32px ABOVE yard only, preserving lower portion. This is still a tall slender mast, not a stubby mast. Reuse existing wood grain, dark edges and left-side warm highlights. Flat pixel sprite, hard edges, genuine alpha transparency, no shadows outside sprite. No redesign of nest or foot.
Candidate 1: clean continuous upper-shaft grain, faithful to reference.
calls.review: Alternative grain candidate; compared in candidates-3x.png, not selected.
